title: A subroutine that multiplies by ten
task: Write a subroutine times10 that multiplies R0 by 10, modulo 2^32, and returns with MOV PC, LR. There is no multiply instruction: 10x = 2 × (x + 4x), and ADD R0, R0, R0, LSL #2 adds 4x in one instruction. The main program loads the word at x (0x800), calls times10 with BL and stores the result at x10 (0x804), calls it again on that result and stores 100x at x100 (0x808), then ends with B . . To run it in a processor view, choose "Extended datapath" in the instruction-set menu: immediates there are 0 to 255. Keep the .equ lines: the tests write the data at those addresses.
starter:
; times-ten -- practice exercise (MAVILERA, ARMv7)
; Store 10x and 100x, with one subroutine called twice.
; Hint: a shifted register operand, then LSL; MOV PC, LR returns.
        .equ  x, 0x800          ; the tests write and read here
        .equ  x10, 0x804        ; the tests write and read here
        .equ  x100, 0x808       ; the tests write and read here

done:   B     done           ; replace with your code; B . ends the run
